Backend (9 pytest, all pass): GET /api/workspace/documents/{aid} returns fields/audit/deadlines, other user's aid -> 404, anon -> 401; POST /audits/{id}/deep with 0 credits -> 402 and no decrement/no deep saved; deep on other user's audit -> 404; deep with credits (1 real Gemini call, ~26s) -> 200, credits 3->2 (exactly -1), findings sources only Documento A/B, second call cached (no extra decrement); /api/packages unchanged (19/49/149/29/99/299); legacy POST/GET/DELETE /api/reminders works and legacy reminder appears in workspace deadlines. One real /api/analyze (PNG invoice, fresh test user) -> 200 in 13s; doc appears in /workspace/documents with ws_synced=true, auto-linked (client_link=auto) to pre-created client by exact P.IVA (IT prefix normalised), payment deadline auto-detected. Frontend: /area anon -> workspace-locked + workspace-login (/?auth=register opens AuthModal); login via AuthModal works, nav-workspace visible; history modal (nav-history) opens; Risk Dashboard KPIs (3/0/2/1/2/1) + 6 priorities; priority click opens doc-panel with audit/fields/deadlines, close works; Clients list Rossi SRL, create client, duplicate P.IVA -> client-new-error, Client 360 all 5 tabs render; Documents: candidates (cand-create-*, cand-link-* via API for fatt1, assign-select, unassign-btn), manual assign updates client name; compare 3 docs -> audit-view with 4 sections + Documento A/B/C sources; audit-deep-btn present with confirm dialog (dismissed, no extra LLM call); Deadlines: bucket tabs, DA VERIFICARE item, confirm-without-date error, edit date, confirm -> Confermata, add manual, delete with confirm dialog. Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow, nav scrollable (overflow-x:auto), doc panel full width. /assistant loads. FOUND + FIXED 1 crash bug (422 validation detail array rendered as React child).

minor.issue: Credit check/decrement not atomic: credits read from get_current_user and `deep` existence checked before a ~25s LLM call, then unconditional $inc -1. Two concurrent clicks/requests (or double-submit from another tab) would both pass checks, call LLM twice and decrement 2 credits; a user with 1 credit could go to -1. Use find_one_and_update({user_id, credits:{$gt:0}}, {$inc:-1}) (refund on failure) and a 'deep_status: running' lock on the audit doc.

Finding filter keeps a finding if ANY source ref is valid, but does not drop the invalid sources inside it (e.g. 'Documento Z' could still be displayed). Also `s.get` on a non-dict source would raise outside the try -> 500 after LLM call. Filter sources to dicts with ref in refs.

Legacy endpoint now also returns workspace auto-detected reminders (status detected/to_verify, possibly due_date ''), so any legacy reminders UI will list unconfirmed auto deadlines. Consider filtering source!='auto' or status=='confirmed' in legacy list if the old UI shows it.
No DELETE client endpoint (test clients cannot be removed by the user).
